source_texts: Definir o contrato que permitirá futuramente apresentar valores consolidados convertidos em uma moeda de referência, sem alterar a moeda nativa dos registros e sem conversão implícita.
requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: A converted result discards the native amount, accepts a quote for an incompatible source/target pair, or fabricates a 1:1 conversion while documentation still appears consistent.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Linked native/reference currency and quote metadata can become semantically incompatible while a converted payload still looks well formed.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: The createConvertedReferenceCurrencyAmount producer accepts different or incompatible linked source/destination currencies, or a same-currency quote with rate 1, instead of rejecting the mutation.
negative_controls.procedure: Exercise the canonical domain producer createConvertedReferenceCurrencyAmount and quote-availability entrypoint with deliberately different linked native, reference, source and destination currency values, then observe the consumer-facing result.
negative_controls.expected: The producer rejects incompatible linked currency relations and same-currency conversion attempts before any converted representation reaches a downstream consumer.
negative_controls.observed: Focused tests on the material head reject source mismatch, target mismatch and fabricated BRL-to-BRL conversion, while valid USD-to-BRL evidence preserves both native and converted values.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Living documentation can continue to label the #596 contract as planned or can imply that an external FX provider became active.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Code and the new contract are published while STATUS_MATRIX or other living documents retain the old planned claim or describe provider-backed conversion as already operational.
negative_controls.procedure: Search living documentation beyond the diff for consolidation, reference-currency, explicit-conversion and ADR 0013 claims; classify current, compatible and contradictory occurrences against the material candidate.
negative_controls.expected: The only prior planned claim is reconciled, unchanged architecture/ADR/API documents remain compatible, and no document claims a productive provider or implicit conversion.
negative_controls.observed: The documentation evidence classifies STATUS_MATRIX as resolved and ADR 0013, EVOLUTION_STRATEGY, ARCHITECTURE, API_FINANCIAL_SUMMARY and API_REPORTS as compatible with no unresolved contradictions.

risk_surfaces.reason: Native currency, reference currency and exchange-rate source/target form a linked semantic relation that must fail closed on incompatibility.
The status transition from planned to implemented must not leave living documentation claiming the previous state or implying productive FX activation.

source_texts: contrato é consumível por Dashboard, Relatórios e futuras projeções;
requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: The shared module exposes an opaque conversion value or documentation tied to one screen, forcing Dashboard, Reports or projections to infer currency or duplicate conversion rules.

negative_controls.failure_mode: One consumer-specific representation forces other financial surfaces to infer reference currency, quote availability or native value semantics.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: The contract documents only Dashboard usage or omits the unavailable state, so Reports and future projections create local fallbacks or implicit conversion behavior.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect the shared subpath export and contract documentation for explicit native, converted and unavailable states plus dedicated sections for Dashboard, Reports and projections.
negative_controls.expected: All three consumer classes can reuse one representation without UI-side quote lookup, native-value replacement or local fallback conversion.
negative_controls.observed: The material contract exports the shared domain subpath and documentation explicitly covers Dashboard, Reports and projections while keeping current currencyBlocks native-only.

risk_surfaces.reason: A future-facing shared contract can be nominally present but unusable by Dashboard, Reports or projections if native, converted and unavailable states are not explicit.
